name: Lyo.Web.Automation.PuppeteerSharp
tagline: PuppeteerSharp backend for `Lyo.Web.Automation`: Chrome, Chromium, Edge, and Firefox sessions, tabs, frames, and the same JSON plans as Playwright and Selenium.
description: PuppeteerSharp backend for the `Lyo.Web.Automation` abstractions. It launches Chrome, Chromium, Edge, or Firefox, owns a session-scoped browser context, and exposes the same tab, frame, dialog, keyboard, and locator helpers as [`Lyo.Web.Automation.Playwright`](../Lyo.Web.Automation.Playwright/README.md) so JSON automation plans behave the same on this engine. WebKit is rejected. This package does not reference `Lyo.Http.Client` or `Lyo.Web.WebRenderer` and does not download a browser.
features: **`PuppeteerSharpBrowser`.** Concrete `IWebAutomationBrowser`. `StartBrowserAsync` launches `BrowserKind` from `BrowserExePath` or `AutomationBrowserDetector` and opens one page in a browser context.
`PuppeteerSharpTabManager` / `PuppeteerSharpBrowserTabInfo`. Engine-native tab info. Portable tab switching stays on `IWebAutomationTabs`.
`PuppeteerSharpWebAutomationElement` and `PuppeteerSharpLocatorFactory`. Map `ElementLocator` (id, name, css, xpath, link text, class, tag) onto Puppeteer selectors.
**Cloudflare handoff is host-owned.** Copy the solver user-agent onto `UserAgents`, `ProxyUrl` onto the context, and cookies onto `CookieJar`. This package does not reference `Lyo.Http.Client`.

sections.title: Service layer ([`Service/`](Service))
items: **`IPuppeteerSharpBrowserService`.** `CreateSession()` clones service options. `CreateSession(Action<PuppeteerSharpBrowserOptions>)` overlays that clone. `CreateSession(new PuppeteerSharpSessionOptions())` replaces it. `ActiveSessionCount`, `Dispose`.

sections.title: Settings ([`Configuration/PuppeteerSharpBrowserOptions.cs`](Configuration/PuppeteerSharpBrowserOptions.cs))
rows: `AutomationBrowserKind`: `Chrome`, `Chromium`, `Edge`, `Firefox`. WebKit is rejected. Firefox drops Chromium launch-arg defaults.

When empty, launch uses `AutomationBrowserDetector` for `BrowserKind` (that browser's env vars, then `BROWSER_PATH` and `PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH`, then install paths). An explicit path wins. Launch throws when the file is missing. No browser download.
Every entry must start with `-`. `ResolveLaunchArguments` adds `--window-size` for Chrome, Chromium, and Edge. Firefox omits those defaults and `--window-size`.
Element wait used by each poll attempt.
